title: Saint Patrick's Cathedral, Karachi
geometryBasis: The 13-point named cathedral footprint establishes the west front, long nave and aisles, paired projecting transept wings, and short chancel.
sectionBasis: The exact Qualla original sets the facade and steeple proportions. The Pakistani embassy documents the 52 by 22 metre overall envelope. Native mapping controls horizontal geometry and the original public DEM controls the forecourt review.
limitations: Tower heights, spire dimensions, chancel fenestration and roof join positions are estimates. Native mapping controls the lower body, while the central front and paired spires are proportioned from the cleared original.
The model covers the cathedral. The independently mapped Christ the King Monument, schools and trees of the precinct are outside this model.
